findings: The approved card requires a plus/minus two-H4-bar high-impact-news entry blackout. Source defaults disable all news modes, and current build_gate_hardening reports EA_CARD_NEWS_WINDOW_MISMATCH because the required 480/480-minute window is absent.

Approved Gate 6 requires the pullback high to be within 0.5 ATR of either broken support L or the most recent significant pullback pivot high. Source lines 285-288 rejects only highs far below L, so highs arbitrarily far above L pass, and it never implements the alternative pivot-high branch.

The card requires 60% partial close at TP1, breakeven protection for the remainder, and TP2 at 1.5 range amplitudes. Source lines 337-348 instead puts the full broker position's take-profit at TP1; lines 378-389 only attempt a breakeven move at the same threshold, so the broker TP closes the whole position and TP2 is never represented.

The approved time stop is 50 completed H4 bars, but source lines 402-407 compares wall-clock elapsed seconds with 50 nominal H4 periods. Weekends and market closures advance this timer without producing H4 bars.

QM5_12932 calls QM_KillSwitchCheck before QM_FrameworkTrackOpenPositionMae at source lines 447-448. When the kill switch returns false, Q08 open-position MAE sampling is skipped, contrary to the V5 skeleton order.

Source lines 350-353 mark the range and entry time as consumed before QM_TM_OpenPosition runs at lines 479-483. A rejected order therefore consumes the one-range-per-break state even though no Phase-E entry occurred.
